name: bundle_view
description: Container-level metadata view: one row per first-class Bundle persisted by this project. Metadata-only (FR-011) — nested clinical content is NOT flattened here; it is promoted to first-class resources covered by the other views (Principle VI). NOTE: an entry_count column (entry.count()) was dropped because the target Aidbox materialization engine does not implement the FHIRPath count() aggregate in column expressions ($materialize HTTP 500: "No method in multimethod 'geval' for dispatch value: count"); the authoritative conformance gate is server acceptance (research.md R5), so the column is omitted rather than materialize-failing the view. Default column set is an informed, reviewable default (FR-002), not a finalized analytics-team contract.

where.description: Scope the view to Bundles persisted by this project's processor (FR-005): match this processor's provenance tag (processed-by = ecr-fhir-processor), version-agnostic. Excludes unrelated Bundle resources on the same server.
